C6362: A command to declare: God is one, the eternal one on whom all depend; he has no offspring and was not born of anyone, and nothing at all is comparable to him.
C3868: The one who charged you with this scripture will return you to a destination. Your Lord knows who brings guidance and who is astray. You never expected a book; it came as mercy, so never back unbelievers or be turned from God's signs. Invoke no other god: everything perishes but his face, judgment is his, and to him you return.
C5141: We sent it down on the night of decree. What could tell you what that night is? It is better than a thousand months: in it the angels and the spirit descend by their Lord's leave with every command, and it is peace until the break of dawn.
C4216: A messenger recites God's clear signs to bring those who believe and do good out of darkness into light; such people enter gardens with rivers flowing beneath, forever, well provided. God made seven heavens and as many earths, his command descending between them, so you know he has power over everything and encompasses everything in knowledge.
C1471: Believers who do good have gardens of paradise as lodging, never wishing to leave. Say: were the sea ink for my Lord's words it would run dry first, even with another sea added. Say: I am only a human like you, told your god is one; whoever hopes to meet his Lord should do good and worship none besides.
C4624: By the sky and the piercing night-visitor star: every soul has a watcher. Let man consider his origin, fluid spurting from between backbone and ribs; God can return him on the day secrets are tested, helpless. By the returning sky and splitting earth, this is decisive speech, no joke. They plot, I plot; grant unbelievers brief respite.
C7212: He gives sons and daughters together, or makes someone barren. God addresses a human only by inspiration, from behind a veil, or through a messenger. So we sent you a spirit; you knew neither book nor faith, but we made it a guiding light. You guide to the straight path of God, to whom all matters return.
C1850: Faces content with their effort, in a high garden free of idle talk: a flowing spring, raised couches, set cups, rowed cushions, spread carpets. Will they not look at how camels were made, the sky raised, mountains fixed, earth spread? Remind; you are no controller over them. Whoever turns away God punishes greatly; they return to us for reckoning.
C4300: Believers, when prayer is called on the day of assembly, hurry to remember God and leave off trading. When the prayer ends, disperse, seek God's bounty and remember him often. Yet when they see a sale or amusement they rush to it and leave you standing. Say: what God has is better than both; he is the best provider.
C8775: You make denial your portion. When a dying soul reaches the throat while you watch, and we are nearer though unseen, why not bring it back if you owe no account? One brought near gets rest, fragrance, a blissful garden; one of the right hand, peace; a straying denier, scalding water and hellfire. This is certain; glorify your Lord.
C6678: Those mindful of their Lord have gardens with flowing rivers forever, as God's hospitality. Some holders of earlier scripture believe in God, in what was sent to you and to them, humbly, not selling God's signs cheaply; their reward awaits, and God reckons swiftly. Believers: be patient, outlast others in patience, stand guard, and fear God to succeed.
C6838: Those who believe in God and hold fast to him he will admit to mercy and guide straight. A ruling on one who dies childless: a lone sister takes half, and he inherits from her if she is childless; two sisters take two thirds; among brothers and sisters, a male gets two females' share. God clarifies lest you stray.
C2208: A prophet tells God: I told them only what you ordered, to worship God, my Lord and theirs; I witnessed them while among them, then you watched. Punish them, they are your servants; forgive them, you are mighty and wise. God answers: today truthfulness profits the truthful: gardens forever, mutual contentment. God rules heavens, earth and all within.
C2460: The crashing blow: what is it, and what could tell you? A day when people are like scattered moths and mountains like tufts of carded wool. Whoever's scales weigh heavy will have a pleasing life; whoever's scales weigh light will have the pit for a mother. And what is that? A raging fire.
C3586: Someone asks who can cure the dying man; he knows it is the parting, leg twists round leg, he is driven to his Lord. He never believed or prayed, but denied and swaggered home: woe upon woe. Is man left purposeless? Was he not a drop, then a clot, shaped into male and female? Cannot that maker revive the dead?
C5748: If wives defect to unbelievers and your turn comes, repay their husbands' outlay. Believing women pledge: no partners for God, no theft, adultery, child-killing, invented slander or disobedience in what is right; accept and ask forgiveness for them. Do not ally with people under God's anger, who despair of the hereafter as unbelievers despair of the buried.
C4980: Before you we sent only inspired men from the towns. Have they not travelled and seen how earlier peoples ended? The next home is better for the mindful. When messengers despaired and thought themselves disbelieved, our help came; the guilty were not spared. Their stories teach the thoughtful: no invented tale, but confirmation, detailed explanation, guidance and mercy.
C9898: He will forgive your sins and admit you to gardens with flowing rivers and fine dwellings, the great triumph, plus what you love: God's help and a near victory. Be God's helpers, as an earlier prophet asked his disciples who would help him and they volunteered. Part of his people believed, part refused; we backed the believers and they prevailed.
C4175: God sent his messenger with guidance and true religion to prevail over all religion. He and his companions are firm against unbelievers, merciful among themselves, bowing and prostrating, faces marked by it. One scripture pictures them so; another as a seed that sprouts, thickens and stands on its stalk, delighting sowers, enraging unbelievers. Forgiveness and great reward are promised.
C9053: We split the earth and grew grain, grapes, greens, olives, palms, dense gardens, fruit and fodder, for you and your livestock. But when the deafening cry comes, a person flees brother, mother, father, spouse and children, each absorbed in his own concern. Some faces that day are bright, laughing, glad; others dusty and darkened: the wicked unbelievers.
C1576: Whoever brings a good deed gets better and is safe from that day's terror; whoever brings evil is thrown face-down into fire. I am ordered to worship the Lord who made this city sacred, to submit, and recite the scripture. The guided benefit themselves; I only warn the stray. God will show signs you will recognize; he misses nothing.
C7418: Those who die unbelieving after blocking God's way are never forgiven. Do not weaken and seek peace while uppermost. This life is play; believe and he rewards you without demanding your wealth, which would expose your grudges. Asked to spend, some are stingy, only toward themselves; God is rich, you are poor. Turn away and he replaces you.
C7780: Had this scripture come down on a mountain, you would see it humbled and split from fear of God, a comparison for reflection. He is God, the only god: knower of hidden and seen, merciful, king, holy, giver of peace and security, guardian, mighty, compeller, supreme, creator, maker, shaper, bearing the finest names, glorified by heaven and earth.
C7375: A command to say: I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak from the harm of what he created, from the harm of darkness when it settles in, from the harm of those who blow on knots, and from the harm of an envier when he envies.
C8229: Scalding water is poured on a man's head as he is mocked as mighty and noble; this they had doubted. The mindful are secure among gardens and springs, in silk and brocade, face to face, paired with wide-eyed companions, calling for any fruit, tasting no second death, spared hell. It was eased in your tongue; wait, as they wait.
C7455: A food only sinners eat. By the seen and unseen: this is a noble messenger's speech, not a poet's or soothsayer's, sent down from the Lord of the worlds. Had he invented sayings about us, we would have seized him and cut his artery, none shielding him. It is a reminder, a regret for unbelievers, certain truth; glorify your Lord.
C4963: When the earth is shaken by its quake and throws out its burdens, and man asks what is wrong with it, that day it tells its news because your Lord inspired it. People emerge in scattered groups to be shown their deeds: whoever did an atom's weight of good will see it, and likewise an atom's weight of evil.
C9948: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people who came with the elephant? He made their scheme go wrong, sent flocks of birds against them that pelted them with stones of baked clay, and left them like chewed-up stalks.
C2725: God owns heavens and earth and witnesses everything. Those who torment believers unrepentant face hell's burning; the faithful get gardens with rivers. Your Lord's grip is severe; he begins and repeats, forgiving, loving, enthroned, doing what he wills. Recall a tyrant's and an ancient people's armies. Deniers are surrounded by God; this glorious recitation is on a guarded tablet.
C1929: We have given you abundance, so pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice. It is the one who hates you who is cut off and left without a future.
C2795: A curse on a certain man: may his hands perish, and may he perish. His wealth and all he gained are no use to him. He will burn in a flaming fire, and so will his wife, the carrier of firewood, with a rope of twisted fibre around her neck.
C2774: Whoever gets his record behind his back will cry for ruin and burn; once happy at home, sure of never returning, but his Lord watched. By twilight, the night and what it gathers, the full moon, you will pass stage after stage. Why do they not believe or bow at recitation? Announce painful punishment, except believers who do good.
C1301: True believers never leave a gathering with the messenger without his leave; grant it as you wish, asking forgiveness for them. Do not treat his summons like calls among yourselves. God knows who slips away under cover; defiers of his order should fear trial or painful punishment. God owns everything, knows your state, and will recount their deeds.
C9483: An oath by charging horses that pant, strike sparks with their hooves, raid at dawn, raise dust and burst into the middle of a host: man is ungrateful to his Lord, witnesses this himself, and loves wealth fiercely. Does he not know that when graves are emptied and what hearts hold is brought out, their Lord will know them completely?
C4495: A soul learns what it brought. By the retreating, hiding stars, departing night and breathing dawn: this is a noble, strong, trusted messenger's word, honored by the throne's lord. Your companion, not mad, saw him on the clear horizon and withholds nothing unseen. No devil's word, so where are you going? It reminds whoever wants straightness, if God wills.
C1114: After other messengers came a prophet, a woman's son, with a scripture, and we put compassion and mercy in his followers' hearts. Monastic life they invented, seeking God's approval, yet kept it poorly; many disobeyed. Believers, fear God and trust his messenger: he gives double mercy, a light to walk by and forgiveness, so scripture-holders know bounty is God's alone.
C8617: The day of rest bound only those who disputed it; your Lord will judge them. Call to your Lord's way with wisdom and good advice, arguing in the best way. If you retaliate, match only what you suffered, though patience is better. Endure; do not grieve or fret over their plots; God is with the mindful and good.
C4470: They claimed a reminder like the ancients' would make them God's devoted servants, yet rejected it. Our messengers were already promised help and our forces victory. Turn away awhile and watch. Do they hurry our punishment? When it lands in their courtyard, the warned face a terrible morning. Glory to your Lord, peace on the messengers, praise to God.
C1427: An oath by time: humankind is surely in a state of loss, except those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to truth, and urge one another to patience.
C7778: Set up no other god; I am a plain warner. Earlier messengers too were called sorcerer or madman, as if by agreement. Turn away blameless, yet remind, which benefits believers. I created unseen beings and humans only to worship me, wanting neither provision nor food from them. Wrongdoers get their predecessors' share; woe to unbelievers on their promised day.
C8283: Aboard a ship they call on God alone, but once ashore worship others, ungrateful for our gifts. We made them a safe sanctuary while people all around are snatched away; yet they believe falsehood and deny God's favor. None is worse than one lying about God or denying truth; hell houses unbelievers. Those who strive for us we guide.
C7987: They say they stayed a day or less; ask those who keep count. He says it was brief, had they known. Did you think we made you pointlessly, never to return? Exalted is God, the true king, lord of the noble throne. Whoever invokes another god without proof answers to his Lord. Say: Lord, forgive and have mercy.
C5256: Their brothers pull them deeper into error. Bring no sign and they ask why you chose none; say you only follow what your Lord reveals, insight, guidance and mercy. When the scripture is recited, listen in silence. Remember your Lord inwardly, humbly, fearfully, in a low voice, morning and evening. Those near him worship without pride and bow down.
C2863: By the fig and the olive, by a named mountain, and by this secure city: we created man in the finest form, then brought him down to the lowest of the low, except those who believe and do good, whose reward never ends. So what can make you deny the judgment after this? Is God not the wisest of judges?
C4381: Have they a god other than God? He is above such partners. Seeing a piece of sky fall, they would call it heaped clouds. Leave them until the day they are thunderstruck, their plotting useless; wrongdoers face nearer punishment too. Patiently await your Lord's judgment, you are in our sight; praise him on rising, at night, as stars fade.
C2718: By bright morning and still night: your Lord has neither left nor hated you. The later is better for you than the earlier; he will give until you are content. He found you orphaned and sheltered you, lost and guided you, poor and enriched you. Do not oppress the orphan or rebuff the beggar, and proclaim your Lord's favor.
C2535: Leave the deniers of this message to me; I lead them on unawares, granting time. Do you charge them a fee? Do they hold the unseen? Wait patiently, unlike the man of the fish, who cried out in anguish; only grace kept him from being cast ashore disgraced. Unbelievers glare and call you mad, yet it reminds all.
C6619: A being boasts superiority: fire-made, the other clay. God expels and curses him until judgment day, yet grants reprieve until a set time. He vows to mislead all but God's chosen servants; God vows to fill hell with him and his followers. Say: I ask no fee and do not pretend; this reminder's truth you will learn.
C9971: Have you seen the one who denies the judgment? He is the one who pushes the orphan away and does not encourage feeding the poor. So woe to those who pray but are careless about their prayer, who only want to be seen, and who withhold even small acts of help.
C6846: Mountains anchored, all for you and your livestock. When the great catastrophe comes, man recalls his striving, hell displayed. Transgressors who preferred this life have hell; whoever feared facing his Lord and curbed desire has the garden. They ask when the hour comes; only your Lord knows; you merely warn. Seeing it, their stay seems one evening or morning.
C5302: Your strivings differ. The mindful giver who affirms the best we ease toward ease; the self-sufficient miser who denies it we ease toward hardship, his wealth useless when he falls. Guidance and both worlds are ours. Fire awaits the wretched denier; spared is the devout who gives wealth for purity, seeking only his Lord's face; he will be satisfied.
C7661: Given mercy after hardship, man calls it his due, doubts the hour, expects the best if ever returned; unbelievers will taste harsh punishment. Favored, he turns aside; harmed, he prays at length. If this is God's and you reject it, who strays further? We will show signs on horizons and within them until truth is clear. God encompasses everything.
C2842: Arrogance and evil scheming, which traps only its authors. Do they await anything but the ancients' fate? God's way never changes or shifts. Have they not travelled and seen how stronger predecessors ended? Nothing escapes God. Were people punished for their deeds, no creature would remain on earth; instead he defers them to a fixed term, seeing his servants.
C4796: Did we not open up your chest, lift from you the burden that weighed down your back, and raise your renown? Truly with hardship comes ease; truly with hardship comes ease. So when you are free, keep striving, and direct your longing to your Lord.
C3948: They said never abandon your gods, naming five idols, and misled many. For their sins they were drowned, then put in fire, helpless. A prophet prays: leave no unbeliever on earth, or they will mislead your servants and breed only ingrates. Forgive me, my parents, believers in my house, all believing men and women; bring wrongdoers only ruin.
C1046: In the name of God, the gracious and merciful. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, gracious and merciful, master of the day of judgment. You alone we worship and you alone we ask for help. Guide us along the straight path, the path of those you have favored, not of those who earned anger or went astray.
C6461: The messenger and the believers believe in God, his angels, books and messengers, without distinguishing among messengers, hearing and obeying. God burdens no soul beyond its capacity; each bears what it earned. Lord, excuse our forgetting and mistakes, do not load us like earlier peoples or beyond our strength; pardon, forgive, have mercy; protector, help us against unbelievers.
